AG1 Ad Teardown

How to read "days running". Meta does not publish spend or results for ordinary ads outside the EU. The only public signal is how long an ad keeps running and how many copies of it the brand spins up. Brands switch off losers within days, so a creative that is still live after 3 to 9 weeks, or that gets cloned into many versions, is very likely paying for itself. Treat it as a strong hint, not proof.

For SILT

Ads to shoot, adapted from what works

Copy the structure, not the asset. Hooks, formats, pacing and offer mechanics are free to borrow. Their footage, scripts, music and claims are not: reusing them is a copyright problem, and their clinical numbers belong to their trial. Every SILT version below uses SILT's own ingredients and claims, and plays to what AG1 does not do: two focused rituals, exact doses, and test results you can check.
